summary: Forex regression iter16 — validated TradingView cleanup + NEW /api/forex/equity endpoint. Backend: 41/42 pytest cases pass (1 pre-existing skip = TP auto-close is non-deterministic on random walk, 1 pre-existing minor drift = BTC/USD 105,419 slightly above the announced 100k-105k band). New iter16 suite (test_forex_iter16.py): 12 pass + 1 conditional skip. All three TradingView-removal checks pass — 0 mentions of 'tradingview' anywhere in /api/forex/symbols, /api/forex/prices or /api/forex/positions responses. New /api/forex/equity endpoint: auth-gated (401 unauth), returns all 7 required keys (balance, unrealized_pnl, equity, margin_used, free_margin, open_position_count, currency), math reconciles exactly (equity == balance + unrealized_pnl, free_margin == equity - margin_used) both with and without open positions. Realized-P&L round-trip verified (open→close reflects in equity.balance). Order validation: lot_size=0 → 422, lot_size=5000 → 400 with clear error. Realtime updates: current_price/pnl_inr changes between /positions?status=open polls. Candles↔prices consistency: last candle mid within 0.5% of live mid. History: multiple open+close events roundtrip correctly. FRONTEND: /forex home renders the balance hero card with all 4 required tiles — TRADING BALANCE (DEMO) ₹9,98,603.94 · UNREALIZED P&L +₹0 · EQUITY ₹9,98,603.94 · OPEN 0. Watchlist shows all 5 symbols with 2026-realistic prices (XAU/USD 3969.97, EUR/USD 1.14685, GBP/USD 1.34077, USD/JPY 157.910, BTC/USD 105,852.52). /forex/symbol/XAUUSD renders WITHOUT blank screen — header, FeedChart with 'DEMO FEED · LIVE' badge, gradient area chart with y-axis grid (4051.97/4021.65/3991.33/3966.53), right-edge price marker, BID(3966.46)/ASK(3966.61)/SPREAD(15.0 pips) cards, SELL/BUY buttons with live subtext, lot presets 0.01/0.1/1/5/10, TP/SL inputs, order summary (Margin ₹100, Balance after ₹9,98,503.94, Contract 100 units), submit button 'BUY 0.1 XAU/USD'. NO iframes anywhere. Price consistency verified numerically across all six read points (chart y-axis last, chart right-marker, BID card, ASK card, SELL subtext, BUY subtext) — all within one 2s tick of each other. NO console errors during login → forex → symbol → order flow (only pre-existing non-blocking 'shadow*' style prop deprecation warnings from RN Web). Sibling regression: /api/wallet, /api/kyc/status, /api/ai/suggestions, /api/notifications, /api/market/dashboard all return 200 for authenticated demo user.

minor.issue: BTC/USD simulated random walk drifted to ~105,419 (0.4% above the announced 100k-105k 2026 band). Not a functional bug — the review requirement says 100k-105k and we're just outside. Consider a mean-reversion term in SimulatedProvider.tick() to keep long-uptime drift within band.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' — carried over from iter15. Reference: any Card/Button component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Does NOT break UX on web preview.

action_items: OPTIONAL P3 — Add mean-reversion in /app/backend/forex/providers.py SimulatedProvider.tick() so BTC/USD stays within 100k-105k over long uptimes.
OPTIONAL P3 — Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across Card/Button components to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.

P4 — TP auto-close test was non-deterministic (skipped when random walk didn't cross TP within 25s). Consider adding a small deterministic push in a test-only endpoint if you want a reliable CI signal. Manual QA already passes: setting a tight TP eventually fires close_reason='tp'.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD — /app/backend/forex/routes.py:159-178 /equity endpoint is a clean composition on top of engine.list_positions + engine.get_or_init_balance. It reads open positions ONCE and sums both pnl_inr and margin_inr in a single loop, so numbers are internally consistent (no race between two mark-to-market calls).

GOOD — /app/backend/forex/routes.py — no more `_tv_symbol` helper, and /symbols response no longer contains tradingview_symbol (confirmed by grep on live response). ForexSymbol type on frontend is also clean.

GOOD — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/forex.tsx (implied) — the balance hero card now shows Balance/Unrealized/Equity/Open in a single tile row, sourced from the new equity endpoint. Layout is tight and information-dense for mobile.

MINOR — /api/forex/positions engine.open_position rejects lot_size above max_lot with 'lot_size must be between 0.01 and 100.0' rather than 'insufficient balance'. Both are 400s so the review requirement is met, but the error phrasing depends on which cap trips first. Consider unifying error copy.

MINOR — /app/frontend/app/forex/symbol/[id].tsx still uses window.confirm() on web (Playwright auto-dismisses in headless which prevents auto-navigation after order). Native mobile uses Alert.alert correctly. Consider replacing web branch with a Toast + auto redirect.
